name: A verandah beside the ruins of a mosque, Bengal
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a raised verandah decorated with scalloped arches, beside ruins identified in the artist's shorthand as those of a mosque. On the back are two studies of an Indian man smoking a nargila or waterpipe.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
